meta.name: app-store-optimization
meta.description: Improves visibility and conversion in the App Store and Google Play — metadata, keywords, screenshots, ratings, and the listing experience that turns an impression into an install. Use this to audit or optimize an app listing, plan a launch listing, diagnose poor install conversion, or improve store search visibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提高应用在商店搜索中的曝光和下载转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在运营一款移动应用,希望让商店页面带来更多下载。
copy.tagline_en: Improve your app's store search visibility and install conversion rate.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a mobile app and want more downloads from a better store listing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的应用商店页面，先判断问题是“搜不到”还是“搜到了没人下载”，再针对标题、关键词、截图、评分等给出具体优化建议；也可用于新应用上架前规划列表或诊断转化率低。
howto.when: 当你要求审查或优化应用商店页面、规划首次上架，或诊断安装转化等问题时触发。

say.text: 为什么我的应用能搜到却没人下载？
say.note: Claude 会检查截图、评分等安装转化因素。

say.text: 帮我改进 Google Play 的标题、关键词和描述。
say.note: Claude 会检查关键词重复并给出商店专属的文案建议。

say.text: 我刚发布新版本，有差评，该怎么回复？
say.note: Claude 会指导具体、不防御的回应，若有修复会说明版本。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits your app listing, distinguishes "found" vs "installed" problems, and gives concrete suggestions on title, keywords, screenshots, ratings. Also helps plan a launch listing or diagnose weak conversion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review or optimize an app store page, plan a launch listing, or diagnose issues like poor install conversion.

say_en.text: Why is my app visible but nobody installs it?
say_en.note: Examines the install page: screenshots, rating prompts, etc.

say_en.text: Help me improve my Google Play title, keywords, and description.
say_en.note: Claude checks repeats and suggests store-specific wording.

say_en.text: I just shipped a new version and got bad reviews. How should I reply?
say_en.note: Specific, non-defensive replies; mention fix version if any.
